title: Repair deadline
passage: When do you expect the lift to be working again? A. The technician said before five. B. I work on the top floor. C. It carries up to eight people.
passageZh:
你預計電梯什麼時候能恢復運作？
A. 技師說五點以前。
B. 我在頂樓工作。
C. 它最多可載八人。
audioScript: When do you expect the lift to be working again? A. The technician said before five. B. I work on the top floor. C. It carries up to eight people.
